props.name: variant
props.doc: Color variant. Defaults to secondary.

props.name: outline
props.doc: Draws an outline instead of a filled tag.

props.name: palette
props.doc: A named Tailwind color family for the tag.

props.name: color
props.doc: Custom fill; set foreground and borderColor too. A theme color name (such as primary, red or magenta) or #rrggbb.

props.name: foreground

props.name: borderColor

props.name: rounded

props.name: roundedFull

components.name: Kbd

props.doc: Uses the outline style.

components.name: Separator

props.name: label

props.name: dashed

props.name: color

components.name: Skeleton

props.name: secondary

props.name: size

components.name: ProgressCircle

props.name: value
props.doc: Completion from 0 to 100.

props.name: loading

props.name: color

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Name read by screen readers.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size. Defaults to medium.

components.name: Avatar

props.name: name
props.doc: Person's name; its initials show when there is no image.

props.name: src
props.doc: Image URL or file path.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Icon shown when there is no image or name.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size. Defaults to medium.

components.name: Alert
components.doc: A callout message with a variant color and optional title.

props.name: message
props.doc: Body text.

props.name: title
props.doc: Bold heading above the message.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Look and icon. Defaults to info.

props.name: banner
props.doc: Full-width banner layout without rounded corners.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Replaces the variant's icon.

props.name: size

props.name: duration

props.name: highlightColor

props.name: reverse

components.name: DescriptionList

props.doc: Puts each label above its value.

props.name: value
props.doc: Value text.

components.doc: One entry in a Breadcrumb.

props.name: label
props.doc: Entry text.

props.name: disabled

props.name: value
props.doc: Text copied when clicked.

props.name: tooltip
props.doc: Tooltip shown on hover.

props.name: tooltipDelay
props.doc: Milliseconds before the tooltip appears.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Name read by screen readers.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size. Defaults to medium.

components.name: Checkbox
components.doc: A checkbox with an optional label. Pair checked with onChange to control it.

props.name: label
props.doc: Text beside the box.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether the box is checked.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.doc: Initial state when `checked` is unset; the control then keeps its own state, like an uncontrolled React input.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disabled boxes ignore clicks.

props.name: tooltip
props.doc: Tooltip shown on hover.

props.name: tooltipDelay
props.doc: Milliseconds before the tooltip appears.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Name read by screen readers when it differs from the label.

props.name: tabIndex
props.doc: Keyboard focus order.

props.name: tabStop
props.doc: False skips the control when tabbing. Defaults to true.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size. Defaults to medium.

props.name: role

components.name: Switch
components.doc: An on/off switch with an optional label. Pair checked with onChange to control it.

props.name: label
props.doc: Text beside the switch.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether the switch is on.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.doc: Initial state when `checked` is unset; the control then keeps its own state, like an uncontrolled React input.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disabled switches ignore clicks.

props.name: tooltip
props.doc: Tooltip shown on hover.

props.name: tooltipDelay
props.doc: Milliseconds before the tooltip appears.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Name read by screen readers when it differs from the label.

props.name: tabIndex
props.doc: Keyboard focus order.

props.name: tabStop
props.doc: False skips the control when tabbing. Defaults to true.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size. Defaults to medium.

props.name: color
props.doc: Track color when on: a theme color name or #rrggbb.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Index of the selected Radio, or -1 for none.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.doc: Initial selected index when `selected` is unset; the group then keeps its own selection.

props.name: vertical
props.doc: Stacks options vertically. Defaults to horizontal.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables every option.

components.name: Radio
components.doc: One option in a RadioGroup; also usable standalone with checked and onChange.

props.name: label
props.doc: Option text.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Selected state of a standalone radio. Inside a RadioGroup, the group's selected index wins.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.doc: Initial state when `checked` is unset; the control then keeps its own state, like an uncontrolled React input.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disabled options cannot be chosen.

props.name: tooltip
props.doc: Tooltip shown on hover.

props.name: tooltipDelay
props.doc: Milliseconds before the tooltip appears.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Name read by screen readers when it differs from the label.

props.name: tabIndex
props.doc: Keyboard focus order.

props.name: tabStop
props.doc: False skips the control when tabbing. Defaults to true.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size. Defaults to medium.

events.doc: Receives true when a standalone radio is chosen.

components.name: Toggle
components.doc: A button that stays pressed while on. Use a label, an icon or both.

props.name: label
props.doc: Text.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Icon.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Pressed (on) state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.doc: Initial state when `checked` is unset; the control then keeps its own state, like an uncontrolled React input.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Prevents toggling.

props.name: tooltip
props.doc: Tooltip shown on hover.

props.name: tooltipDelay
props.doc: Milliseconds before the tooltip appears.

props.name: size
props.doc: Control size. Defaults to medium.

events.doc: Receives the new pressed state.

components.name: Rating
components.doc: A star rating input.

props.name: value
props.doc: Number of filled stars.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: Initial rating when `value` is unset; the rating then keeps its own value.

props.name: max
props.doc: Total stars. Defaults to 5.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disabled ratings ignore clicks.

props.name: color
props.doc: Star color: a theme color name or #rrggbb.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size. Defaults to medium.

props.name: page
props.doc: Current page.

props.name: total
props.doc: Number of pages.

props.name: compact
props.doc: Shows only previous and next buttons.

events.doc: Receives the requested page.

components.name: Slider
components.doc: A draggable numeric slider.

props.name: value
props.doc: Current value.

props.name: min
props.doc: Lowest value. Defaults to 0.

props.name: max
props.doc: Highest value. Defaults to 100.

props.name: step
props.doc: Value increment. Defaults to 1.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disabled sliders ignore input.

events.doc: Receives the new value while dragging.

components.name: Stepper
components.doc: Progress through numbered steps. Children are StepperItem elements.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Index of the current step.

props.name: vertical
props.doc: Stacks steps vertically.

components.name: StepperItem
components.doc: One step in a Stepper.

props.name: label
props.doc: Step title.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Greys the step out.

components.name: Tabs
components.doc: A row of Tab triggers that switches between TabsContent panels.

props.name: value
props.doc: The selected tab's value, controlled; set it from onChange. Without it the tabs keep their own selection.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: Initially selected tab value when `value` is unset. Defaults to the first tab.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Tab style: tab (default), underline, pill, outline, segmented or folder (browser-style tabs that join the content below).

props.name: menu
props.doc: Adds a menu listing every tab, for bars that overflow.

props.name: maxWidth
props.doc: Most width in pixels before the bar scrolls.

props.name: size
props.doc: Tab size: xsmall, small, medium (default) or large.

events.doc: Runs with the clicked tab's value.

components.children: Tab, TabsContent, TabsPrefix, TabsSuffix and TabsEmptySpace

<Tabs defaultValue="account">
  <Tab value="account">Account</Tab>

  <TabsContent value="account"><Text>Make changes to your account here.</Text></TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="password"><Text>Change your password here.</Text></TabsContent>
</Tabs>

components.name: Tab
components.doc: One tab trigger. Text children are its label.

props.name: value

props.doc: Tab text, when there are no text children.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Icon before the label; an icon-only tab is square.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Names an icon-only tab.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Overrides the bar's style for this tab.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Shown but cannot be selected.

components.example:
<Tabs defaultValue="account">

  <Tab value="password">Password</Tab>

components.name: Accordion

props.name: open
props.doc: Whether the content is visible.

components.name: Select
components.doc: A button that opens a list of options and shows the chosen one. Options come from SelectItem children (optionally inside SelectGroup) or the items prop.

props.name: items
props.doc: Plain options whose label is also the value; SelectItem children add more.

props.name: value
props.doc: The selected option's value, controlled; set it from onChange. Without it the select keeps its own selection.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: Initially selected value when `value` is unset.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Text shown while nothing is selected.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Ignores clicks and keys.

props.name: searchable
props.doc: Adds a search field that filters the options. Read when the select mounts.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.doc: Hint in the search field.

props.name: cleanable
props.doc: Shows a clear button while an option is selected; clearing reports an empty value.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Icon in place of the dropdown caret.

props.name: titlePrefix
props.doc: Text before the selected label, such as "Country: ".

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: A name that stays the same as the selection changes.

props.name: appearance
props.doc: false draws the bare trigger without border and background.

props.name: menuWidth
props.doc: Width of the open list in pixels. Defaults to the trigger's width.

props.name: menuMaxHeight
props.doc: Most height in pixels the open list takes before it scrolls.

props.name: scrollBounce
props.doc: Elastic overscroll in the list. Defaults to the platform's behavior.

props.name: autoFocus
props.doc: Focuses the select when it mounts.

props.name: size
props.doc: Control size: xsmall, small, medium (default) or large.

events.doc: Runs with the chosen value, or empty when cleared.

components.example:
<Select placeholder="Select a fruit" value={fruit} onChange={(value) => { fruit.set(value); }}>

    <SelectItem value="banana">Banana</SelectItem>

</Select>

props.name: disabled

components.name: CodeEditor

props.name: value
props.doc: Editor text.

props.name: language

props.name: readOnly

props.name: foreground
props.doc: Custom variant text color.

props.name: hoverColor
props.doc: Custom variant hover fill.

props.name: activeColor

props.name: label

props.name: icon

props.name: disabled

components.name: InputGroup

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Draws the frame in the destructive color.

props.name: size

components.name: InputGroupAddon

props.name: align
props.doc: Where the addon sits: before (inline-start, the default) or after (inline-end) the text, or above (block-start) or below (block-end) it.

components.name: InputGroupButton

props.name: label

props.name: icon

props.name: variant
props.doc: Visual style. Defaults to ghost.

props.name: outline

props.name: disabled

props.name: loading

props.name: loadingIcon

props.name: tooltip

props.name: tooltipDelay

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Names an icon-only button.

props.name: tabIndex
props.doc: Keyboard focus order.

props.name: caret

props.name: color
props.doc: Custom fill: a theme color, palette color such as blue-500, or hex.

props.name: variant

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows a spinner instead of the icon.

components.name: Attachment
components.doc: One file or media item with a title, description, upload status and remove/retry controls.

props.name: title
props.doc: File name or title.

props.name: description
props.doc: Secondary text, such as PDF · 2.4 MB.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Preview icon. Defaults to file.

props.name: image
props.doc: Path of a local image used as the preview.

props.name: status

components.name: AttachmentGroup

props.name: rows

props.name: title

props.name: description

props.name: description

props.name: vertical
props.doc: Stacks the panels top to bottom instead of side by side.

props.name: title
props.doc: Tab title.

components.name: Question
components.doc: One question in a Questionnaire; its QuestionChoice children are the answers.

props.name: id
props.doc: Key of this question in the submitted answers.

props.name: title
props.doc: The question.

props.name: description
props.doc: Help text under the question.

props.name: required
props.doc: Requires an answer before continuing.

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Allows several choices; Next continues.

components.name: QuestionChoice
components.doc: One answer to a Question.

props.name: id
props.doc: Value recorded in the answers.

props.name: label
props.doc: Displayed text.

props.name: description
props.doc: Secondary text under the label.

components.name: SpeechButton
components.doc: A microphone button that dictates with the system speech recognizer (macOS and Windows). Click to start; click again to stop and receive the final transcript.

props.name: waveform
props.doc: Shows the input level beside the button while listening.

events.doc: Receives the whole transcript so far while the user speaks.

components.name: Plot

props.doc: Category labels along the x axis, one per value.

props.doc: Draws the x axis with labels. Defaults to false.

components.doc: A line through one value per Plot label.

props.name: values

props.name: color

props.name: dots

props.name: width

props.name: values

props.name: values

props.name: color
